title: artemisia petrosa subsp. eriantha
intro: Artemisia petrosa subsp. eriantha, commonly known as Mountain Sage, is a shrubby perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Sage include its ability to calm the mind and body, as well as its potential to soothe respiratory issues and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
